method: Deep-research replay derived from the already-frozen 2021Q2 event set. Company evidence, expectation paths and deterministic pre-cutoff regime snapshots are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before deep memos lock.
V1.2 expectation paths use contemporaneous public forecasts rather than reconstructed later earnings.
equityReturnArchetype is a descriptive research label only and does not alter the frozen V1.2 selection gates.
